name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v558: stops the TV crash for good. The crash was a linkage mismatch: on the TV the plugin classloader had a SettingsDialog from one build calling a SettingsWebView from another, so the expected static field did not exist (NoSuchFieldError). v558 wraps every cross-class solver call in a Throwable guard, so a stale or duplicate plugin dex can no longer kill the app - worst case you get a Toast naming the failure and playback continues. Applies to the Open button in Cloudflare Bypass settings, the Febbox/GramCinema Login button, and the mid-playback probe. If the TV still shows a Toast, remove every CineStream entry from Plugins, force-stop CloudStream, then install this build once. All v556/v557 behaviour retained: invisible mode only falls back to visible at app open, kwik.cx challenges fail silently, pre-playback probe validates the mirror holding the cookie, isCookieValid retries transient interstitials, pre-purge clearance snapshot prevents stale cookie saves.
